text: Design a local usage logger for our xAI client — append JSONL under ~/.grok-hq/usage/ without ever writing the API key.
Plan: wrap the chat.completions call; on each response append one line with ts, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, project. Key stays in env only. Verified shape against hq.py collect_usage.
Also seed a demo session so brief doesn't crash on empty store.
Done. demo/sessions/ ships two JSONL files; hq install copies them into ~/.grok-hq/sessions/ when empty.
